summary: Frontend-only verification of unified multi-key rotation + model fallback + safe JSON parsing + no-sticky-offline + UI preservation. 7/7 assertions PASS on desktop 1920x900 with localStorage cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: services/gemini.js: API_KEYS = [RAG, RAG_BACKUP, SIDEKICK].filter(Boolean) — correct unified rotation array; MODEL_CHAIN de-dupes env model into working models first (gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-flash-latest) then retired legacy models as last-resort — matches spec.

generate() correctly: 404 -> break to next MODEL; KEY_ROTATE {429,403,500,503}/timeout/network -> continue to next KEY; only throws after every model+key combo exhausted. Verified via mocked 429 on first call: console logged 'key #1 on gemini-3.5-flash failed (429) — rotating to next key' and the app served a grounded answer with the next key.

sanitizeText() strips ```json fences and unwraps {"answer":...} — verified live: injected fenced-JSON body rendered as clean 'Reflection is light bouncing off a surface' with a clickable citation-0030 pill, no backticks/braces leaked to UI.
askQuestion() runs fresh per request (no sticky offline flag) — verified: after simulated 429, removing the route and asking a new question returned grounded-badge immediately.
Sidekick key returns 403 (project denied) in the wild but rotation to RAG keys keeps sidekick pipeline functional — OOS 'FIFA World Cup' correctly rendered sidekick-badge.
keyStatus.model pill in EvidenceViewer footer reads 'gemini-3.5-flash' as expected.
seed_data_creation: localStorage/sessionStorage cleared at run start; New Chat between assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Detailed results — (1) LIVE GROUNDED 'What is reflection of light?': grounded-badge with 3 citations (01:38, 01:48, 01:42) in ~3-5s. (2) KEY ROTATION: page.route injected HTTP 429 on the FIRST generateContent call; console showed rotation warning and second call succeeded — final badge = grounded, NOT offline. (3) 404 skip: legacy retired models are last in MODEL_CHAIN and skipped instantly per code; normal flow returned grounded with no crash. (4) NO STICKY OFFLINE: after unroute, fresh Q 'What is refraction?' -> grounded-badge. (5) SAFE JSON: injected fenced-JSON body rendered clean text 'Reflection is light bouncing off a surface' with citation-0030 clickable; no backticks/braces in DOM. (6) OOS 'FIFA World Cup' -> sidekick-badge + sidekick-message. (7) UI regressions: send-btn disabled on empty, sidebar-toggle collapses/expands, video-placeholder shown (lecture-video hidden until playback trigger — acceptable per spec 'lecture-video OR video-placeholder'), citation click populates evidence-quote+evidence-speaker, mic-btn toggles without crash, export-btn enabled after Q/A, model pill = gemini-3.5-flash. Rotation refactor is production-ready.
rca of the issue: N/A — refactor validated. Rotation engine works: 404 -> next model, 429/403/5xx/timeout -> next key, returns first success, no sticky offline.
